login.title: Wallet
login.subtitle: Money, credits and bank — only from the Quilax app
login.noDirectEntryBody: This site does not accept email or password in normal use. This protects deposits and withdrawals: it only opens from your Quilax session.
login.step1Body: Sign in to the app (mobile or web) with your account.
login.step2Body: At the bottom you'll see the wallet / Wallet icon.
login.step3Body: Tap the button: it brings you here already signed in, no password needed.
login.bookmarkNote: If you arrived via a link or bookmark, go back to Quilax and open it from Wallet.
login.recoverySubtitle: Only if your account is suspended for inappropriate content
login.recoveryHeroBody: The game app stays blocked. Here you can only see the suspension message and withdraw the remaining balance to your linked bank account.
login.wrongEntry: This entry is only for accounts suspended for content. Enter from the Quilax app → Wallet.
login.banSuspicious: Account suspended for suspicious activity. Balance cannot be recovered.
login.banGeneric: Account suspended. You cannot recover balance from here.

home.title: Wallet
home.subtitleReady: Account ready. Buy credits or withdraw to your bank.
home.subtitlePending: You can buy credits now. To withdraw, link your bank (IBAN) with Stripe.
home.identityPendingBody: Document and selfie verification is done in the Quilax app (when you register or in Settings). Here you only manage money.
home.bankPendingBody: Complete Stripe Connect onboarding to withdraw. The card for buying credits is requested when paying, not here.
home.bankMissingBody: To withdraw you need to link your bank (IBAN) with Stripe Connect. The purchase card is entered only when adding credits.
home.lockWithdraw: To withdraw you need your bank account (IBAN) verified with Stripe Connect. This is not your purchase card.
home.lockDeposit2fa: To add credits you need Google Authenticator (2FA). Tap the notice below or go to Set up 2FA.
home.lockWithdraw2fa: To withdraw you need Google Authenticator (2FA). Tap the notice below or go to Set up 2FA.
home.lockWithdrawBlocked: You cannot withdraw right now. Check bank and account requirements.
home.protectMoneyBody: Enable Google Authenticator for deposits and withdrawals →

deposit.title: Add credits
deposit.subtitleAmount: Enter how many credits you want to buy.
deposit.fiatHint: 1 credit ≈ 1 EUR · charge includes card fee · currency {{currency}}
deposit.quizHint: Joining each quiz costs 1 credit. The amount charged includes Stripe’s estimated card fee; you receive the credits shown.
deposit.need2fa: You must set up Google Authenticator before paying.
deposit.confirmPaymentHint: You are buying {{credits}} credits. You will be charged {{amount}} (includes card fee). Enter your Google Authenticator code.
deposit.paymentConfirmedBody: When Stripe confirms the charge, the {{credits}} credits will be added to your balance automatically.

withdraw.title: Withdraw
withdraw.verificationCopy: Withdrawals are only available when Stripe confirms your Connect account and IBAN (status: Ready for withdrawals).
withdraw.needBankVerification: Complete bank verification with Stripe before withdrawing.
withdraw.need2fa: You must set up Google Authenticator before withdrawing.
withdraw.pendingReview: Withdrawal received: pending manual review before bank payout.

history.title: History
history.subtitle: All account activity.
history.downloadHint: For your bank or tax advisor: prizes and withdrawals in your name.

legal.title: Terms and privacy
legal.subtitle: Conditions for deposits, withdrawals and credits.
legal.intro: Operational summary for Wallet. The Quilax app shows the full text in Settings → Terms / Privacy.
legal.moneyHereBody: Deposits and withdrawals are managed on this Wallet site, not in chat or quizzes. Payments go through Stripe.
legal.creditsBody: Credits have a reference monetary value. Prizes are calculated when each quiz closes according to its rules. Fraud or multi-accounting may void prizes.
legal.withdrawBody: Require a verified bank account and may go through anti-fraud review. Timing depends on your bank.
legal.privacyBody: We process account, KYC and payment data to provide the service and prevent fraud (GDPR). Contact: privacy@quilax.com

recover.title: Recover balance
recover.subtitle: Balance recovery — inappropriate content only
recover.defaultBanMessage: Your account was suspended for posting content that violates the rules.
recover.noBankBody: To withdraw you need verified Stripe Connect. If you didn't complete it before suspension, contact support with your account email. You cannot deposit or play while suspended.
recover.canWithdrawHint: You can withdraw the full remaining balance to your linked account. The game app stays blocked.
recover.noBalance: You have no remaining balance to withdraw.
recover.noConnect: No verified Stripe Connect account. Complete bank linking or contact support from the app before suspension, or email support with your address.
recover.confirmWithdrawHint: Open Google Authenticator and enter the 6-digit code.
recover.donePending: Request sent. Pending review before payout.
recover.doneSuccess: Withdrawal requested. Balance will be transferred to your linked account.

bank.title: Bank account
bank.subtitle: Choose your country and verify with Stripe Connect to withdraw.
bank.copy: Quilax uses Stripe Connect Express. You complete onboarding, link your bank and, once Stripe confirms payouts, you can withdraw credits.

security.title: Security
security.twoFactorActiveSubtitle: Your account already has Google Authenticator.
security.twoFactorActiveBody: Each deposit or withdrawal will ask for a 6-digit code from the app.
security.googleAuthSubtitle: Protect deposits and withdrawals with a code only you have.
security.setupSteps:
1. Open Google Authenticator (or another TOTP app).
2. Scan the QR or enter the key manually.
3. Confirm with the 6-digit code.
security.confirmCodeHint: Enter the current Google Authenticator code to enable 2FA.
security.successBody: Google Authenticator enabled. You can now operate with credits.
security.rescanHint: If you change phones or Authenticator apps, enter your current code to generate a new QR. Delete the old Authenticator entry before scanning.
security.rescanBody: Scan the new QR and activate 2FA again with the 6-digit code.
security.lostDeviceHint: If you lost your phone and don’t have a code, contact support — we can’t reset 2FA without verifying it’s you.

identity.title: Verification submitted
identity.body: You can return to the Quilax app. The result will update in a few seconds.

stripe.webOnly: Card payments are available on Wallet (web).
stripe.configMissing: Missing Stripe configuration (publishable key or client secret).

totp.defaultHint: Open Google Authenticator and enter the 6-digit code.
